recommended_usage: twice daily (in the morning and the evening)
single_dose: not explicitly stated, but applied to affected area of skin twice daily
mechanism_of_action: attacks bacteria on the skin called P.acnes, reduces growth of outermost skin cells that block pores, has anti-inflammatory properties
side_effects: burning, itching, pain and dry skin at the application site, allergic reaction (swelling of face, difficulty breathing, rapid swelling under the skin)
activation_conditions: requires stimulation (cleaning and drying skin before application), requires specific timing (twice daily in the morning and evening)
storage_conditions: store at room temperature, protect from light
